proposed_rules.trigger: A page URL matches /integrations/integrations-<partner>-knack and shows the recurring sequence: hero title, how-it-works intro+demo, 3-step block, automation-templates grid, feature-highlight panel, triggers/actions table, CTA link, about-partner text, related content.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a fixed page template with stable section/block order across all partner pages instead of deriving fresh boundaries per page.
proposed_rules.rationale: Keeps ~90 partner-integration pages consistent. Rejected alternative: independent per-page derivation, which would fragment identical structures into differently-named blocks.
